desk: Retainer health and capacity — month-end review
title: Capacity board, month-end
prompt: Documentary photograph inside a small Australian creative agency studio at month-end: a large whiteboard wall ruled into a neat grid with thin black tape, filled with rows of blank coloured magnetic cards in yellow, coral pink and pale blue, a few rows visibly overcrowded with cards spilling past the tape line. One anonymous hand, seen from the side, moves a card from a crowded row to an emptier one. Exposed brick, a trailing pothos plant on a shelf, soft morning daylight from tall warehouse windows, shallow depth of field, natural colours, calm and organised mood. The cards and the board are completely blank, with no writing or marks.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
